## 🎯 Feature Summary
A clear and concise description of what feature or enhancement you would like to see.

## 💡 Problem / Motivation
Is your feature request related to a problem or limitation? (e.g., *"I'm always frustrated when [...]"* or *"It would be great if the council could [...]"*).

## 🚀 Proposed Solution
Describe the solution you'd like:
- Architectural changes
- New persona or deliberation workflow
- New factor calculation or visualization
- UI enhancement

## 🔍 Alternatives Considered
A clear and concise description of any alternative solutions or features you've considered.

## 📚 References & Academic Papers (Optional)
If applicable, include links to research papers, Qlib factors, or relevant libraries.
